summary: Verified mismatch: existing V1.5 worker kernel allows each response to terminate after assigned work; hyperscale shift plan treats authenticated STOP principally as shift/runner control and AUTO_STOP_ON_EMPTY, not a strict per-response stop gate. Owner clarified intended START = manual worker prompt; active worker performs multiple authorized jobs and inbox reads within a response; normal final response only after verified STOP/DRAIN, except forced platform/tool/budget/safety boundary with durable YIELDED. Recommend contract addendum for control-gated multi-job response loops, periodic control reads and audit card, no pseudo push signal or indefinite execution guarantee. No source/config changes.
